title: hieracium nigrescens subsp. amblyphyllarioides
intro: Hieracium nigrescens subsp. amblyphyllarioides, commonly known as a species of hawkweed, is a plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium nigrescens subsp. amblyphyllarioides include its ability to stimulate digestion and reduce symptoms of digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
